messages.author: f151fee17824cf2e
messages.subject: comparison matrix issue
parts:
Hi MSstats Team,
                                I am trying to do MSstats analysis on Galaxy with  MaxQuant generated evidence and protein groups files along with annotation and comparison matrix files that I created. This is the comparison matrix I created. 
Name     Q23 Q74.  
Q23-Q74 1 -1 
  I keep getting the error "Error in MSstatsContrastMatrix.matrix(contrast.matrix, groups) : Assertion on 'colnames of contrast matrix' failed: Must be equal to set {'NA'}, but is {}. Calls: groupComparison ... MSstatsContrastMatrix.matrix -> <Anonymous> -> makeAssertion -> mstop Execution halted Can anyone please help me out in solving this issue?

messages.author: 3f7dab23a7bc0436
messages.subject: Re: comparison matrix issue
parts:
Hi,

Could you also attach your annotation file?  That'll make it easier to assess the problem.

From initial glance, there are 2 criteria that need to be met that your matrix may not be satisfying:
  • Column names of your matrix must be the same as your condition labels.  
  • The matrix should include all condition labels (i.e. if you have 3 conditions, you'll have 3 columns in your contrast matrix).
Thanks,
Tony

messages.author: 3f7dab23a7bc0436
messages.subject: Re: comparison matrix issue
parts:
Hi,

Taking a look at your evidence file, the values in the `Raw file` column do not match with the values in the `Raw.file` column in your annotation file.

E.g. in the evidence file, we see "Q23_01.raw.thermo", but in the annotation, we see "Q23_01.raw".  Once you ensure your values match up completely, that bug you reported should not appear.

Thanks,
Tony
